title: leptospermum polygalifolium var. citriodorum
intro: Leptospermum polygalifolium var. citriodorum, commonly known as Lemon-scented Tea Tree, is a variant of the Leptospermum polygalifolium plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties that can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Lemon-scented Tea Tree include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of Leptospermum polygalifolium var. citriodorum include essential oils such as citral, geraniol, and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
